hotel: the Vila Joya hotel (4 rooms and 9 suites)
bookingOpens: By request form on the restaurant's website; the team calls to talk the booking through, and it isn't valid until confirmed by email. Hotel guests get priority at dinner, so few dinner tables are open to others. For a table the same day, call before 11am.
cancellation: Free to cancel until 9am on the day. Later cancellations cost €150 a person; no-shows, and each guest fewer than booked, are charged €290 a person.
